catches: Promo code NEIGHBOR is required when opening — without it the bonus does not apply.
Within 90 days you must complete both: qualifying payroll/pension/government direct deposits totaling $2,000 AND 25 debit card purchases of at least $5 each.

If you close the account within 12 months, the bonus is reclaimed.

steps: Open a new Neighborhood Credit Union checking account at https://www.myncu.com/bank/checking/cash-bonus using promo code NEIGHBOR (opening deposit generally $25).
Within 90 days, receive qualifying payroll/pension/government direct deposits totaling $2,000 or more.
Within the same 90 days, make at least 25 debit card purchases of at least $5 each.
Keep the account open and in good standing with a balance of at least $25.
The $300 bonus is deposited to your savings account within 120 days. Offer expires December 31, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. CT; closing the account within 12 months reclaims the bonus.
